requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1a, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 2.50∙102 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.20∙103 cd when used as a single lamp and 6.00∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 3∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 250-1200 cd (600 cd for D), follow Figure A3-I and are ≥0.3 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 1b, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 4.00∙102 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 1.20∙103 cd when used as a single lamp and 6.00∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-I and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-1 shall be 7∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 400-1200 cd (600 cd for D), follow Figure A3-I and are ≥0.7 cd within Table A2-1 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 5, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 6∙10-1 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", the standard light distribution shall be as in Table A2-2 and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-2 shall be 6∙10-1 cd, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 0.6-280 cd (140 cd for D) and ≥0.6 cd within Table A2-2 angles.

requirements.text: For a direction indicator of category 6, the minimum luminous intensity shall be 5.0∙101 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 2.80∙102 cd when used as a single lamp and 1.40∙102 cd when used as a lamp marked "D", and the standard light distribution shall be as in Figure A3-IV, as specified in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement; pass if intensities are within 50-280 cd (140 cd for D) and follow Figure A3-IV.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of direction indicator lamps within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as given in Table 8.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the geometric visibility angle limits; pass if Table 8 minimum values are met.

requirements.text: The intensities of direction indicator lamps shall in general be measured with the light source(s) continuously alight, except that depending on the construction of the lamp, for example, the use of light-emitting diodes (LED), or the need to take precautions to avoid overheating, it is allowed to measure the lamps in flashing mode.
requirements.test_case: Check the photometric test report states continuous or justified flashing-mode measurement.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, each light source, after its activation, shall remain lit until the end of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Observe the lamp in flashing mode and verify each activated light source stays lit until the end of the ON cycle.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the sequence of activation of the light sources shall produce a signal which proceeds in a uniform progressive manner from inboard towards the outboard edge of the light emitting surface.
requirements.test_case: Record the flashing sequence and verify uniform progression from inboard to outboard edge.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the signal shall be one signal with no interruption and no vertical oscillations (e.g. not more than one change of direction along the vertical axis).
requirements.test_case: Record the sequence and verify a single uninterrupted signal with at most one vertical direction change.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the distance between two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the light emitting surface of the sequential direction indicator shall not exceed 50mm, when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, instead of the values defined in paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 48 or paragraph 5.7.2. of UN Regulation No. 86 or paragraph 5.6.2. of UN Regulation No. 53.
requirements.test_case: Measure gaps between distinct light emitting surface parts perpendicular to the reference axis; each ≤ 50 mm.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the variation shall finish no more than 200ms after the beginning of the ON cycle.
requirements.test_case: Measure timing of the sequence with a photodetector; full activation reached ≤ 200 ms after ON cycle start.

requirements.text: For direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c or 12 where the flash is produced by sequential activation of their light sources, the ratio of the horizontal to the vertical sides of the circumscribing rectangle shall not be less than 1.7.
requirements.test_case: Measure the circumscribing rectangle; horizontal/vertical ratio ≥ 1.7.

requirements.text: The direction indicator lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the failure tests of paragraph 4.6 and verify compliance.

requirements.text: The colour of light emitted by the direction indicator lamps shall be amber.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates and verify they lie within the amber boundaries.

requirements.text: The light emitted by each of the two samples supplied of the side marker lamps shall meet the requirements in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement of both samples against Table 9 values.

requirements.text: For side marker lamps of category SM1, the minimum luminous intensity in the axis of reference shall be 4.0 cd, the minimum luminous intensity within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VII shall be 0.6 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 25.0 cd, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3 shall be 0.6 cd, as specified in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities: axis ≥ 4.0 cd, distribution points ≥ 0.6 cd, max ≤ 25 cd, geometric visibility field ≥ 0.6 cd.

requirements.text: For side marker lamps of category SM2, the minimum luminous intensity in the axis of reference shall be 0.6 cd, the minimum luminous intensity within the standard light distribution of Figure A3-VIII shall be 0.6 cd, the maximum luminous intensity shall be 25.0 cd, and the minimum luminous intensity within the angles of geometric visibility defined in Table A2-3 shall be 0.6 cd, as specified in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensities: axis ≥ 0.6 cd, distribution points ≥ 0.6 cd, max ≤ 25 cd, geometric visibility field ≥ 0.6 cd.

requirements.text: The minimum luminous intensity of the side marker lamps within the angles of geometric visibility shall be as specified in Table 9.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity within the geometric visibility field per Table A2-3; ≥ 0.6 cd.

requirements.text: The side marker lamps shall meet the failure provisions of paragraph 4.6.
requirements.test_case: Perform the failure tests of paragraph 4.6 and verify compliance.

requirements.text: The colour of the light emitted by the side marker lamps shall be amber, except that it can be red, if the rearmost side marker lamp is grouped or combined or reciprocally incorporated with the rear position lamp, the rear end-outline marker lamp, the rear fog lamp, the stop lamp, or is grouped with or has part of the light emitting surface in common with the rear retro-reflector.
requirements.test_case: Measure chromaticity coordinates and verify they lie within the amber boundaries.

requirements.text: The measured values shall not deviate unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the values prescribed in this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Photometrically measure production lamps; pass if no value deviates unfavourably by more than 20 per cent from the prescribed values.

requirements.text: The measured values shall correspond to the values shown in Table 12 for the minimum values required throughout the fields specified in Annexes 2 and 3.
requirements.test_case: Measure production lamps at the field points of Annexes 2 and 3; pass if measured values are not below the Table 12 equivalents.

requirements.text: If not otherwise specified, the minimum intensities given in Figures A3-I to A3-XV for the various directions of measurement as a percentage of the minimum intensities required shall be mathematically rounded down to three significant digits, except that in the case where one of the following lamps is intended to be installed at a mounting height (using the H plane specified by the manufacturer) equal to or less than 750 mm above the ground, the photometric intensity is verified only up to an angle of 5° downwards: (a) Front and rear direction indicators lamps; (b) Front and rear position lamps; (c) Front and rear end-outline marker lamps; (d) Parking lamps; (e) Stop lamps of category S1, S2 and MS; (f) Side marker lamps.
requirements.test_case: Goniophotometric measurement: compute each grid-point minimum as the rounded-down (3 significant digits) percentage of the table minimum and check measured values meet it, limiting downward check to 5° if mounting height ≤ 750 mm.

requirements.text: The light intensity in each direction of a part of the field formed by the grid lines shall meet at least the lowest minimum value being shown on the grid lines surrounding the questioned direction as a percentage, within the field of light distribution schematically shown as a grid.
requirements.test_case: Scan intensity between grid lines with a goniophotometer and verify no direction falls below the lowest surrounding grid-point minimum percentage.

requirements.text: The front and rear position lamps, parking lamps, front and rear end-outline marker lamps, stop lamps (S1, S2 and MS) and direction indicator lamps of categories 1, 1a, 1b, 2a, 2b, 11, 11a, 11b, 11c, 12 shall meet, for the various directions of measurement, the minimum intensities as a percentage of the minimum intensities required (see Tables 3, 4, 5, 7 and 8) given in Figure A3-I.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at the Figure A3-I grid points and verify each meets the stated percentage of the applicable table minimum.

requirements.text: The daytime running lamp shall be subjected to a one-hour test of continuous operation following a warm-up period of 20 minutes.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp for a 20-minute warm-up followed by 60 minutes of continuous operation and record the durations.

requirements.text: The ambient temperature for the heat resistance test of the daytime running lamp shall be 23 °C ± 5 °C.
requirements.test_case: Log the ambient temperature throughout the heat test and confirm it stays within 18 °C to 28 °C.

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps equipped with non-replaceable light sources (filament light sources and other), the heat resistance test shall be made with the light sources present in the lamp, in accordance with paragraph 5.4.5. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: Verify the test is run on the lamp with its own non-replaceable light sources under the paragraph 5.4.5 conditions.

requirements.text: After the daytime running lamp has been stabilized at the ambient temperature following the heat resistance test, no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour modification shall be perceptible.
requirements.test_case: Visually inspect the lamp after stabilisation; pass if no distortion, deformation, cracking or colour change is visible.

requirements.text: In case of doubt, the intensity of light of the daytime running lamp shall be measured according to paragraph 5 of this Regulation and the values shall reach at least 90 per cent of the values obtained before the heat resistance test on the same lamp.
requirements.test_case: Measure photometric values before and after the heat test; pass if post-test values are at least 90 per cent of pre-test values.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using incandescent technology only, the luminous intensities measured after photometric stability shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Operate the lamp until photometric stability and measure luminous intensities at all test points; pass if all values lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: The luminous intensities for all other lamps (other than those mentioned in 1.2.1), measured after 1 min and either after 30 minutes of operation, or after photometric stability has occurred, shall comply with the minimum and maximum requirements.
requirements.test_case: Measure luminous intensities after 1 min and after 30 min (or after photometric stability); pass if all values at every test point lie within the minimum and maximum limits.

requirements.text: For lamps (functions) using light source technologies other than incandescent technology only, operation of direction indicator lamps shall be done in flashing mode (f = 1.5 Hz, duty factor 50 per cent).
requirements.test_case: Verify the test set-up operates the direction indicator at 1.5 Hz with 50 per cent duty factor during the 1 min and 30 min/stability measurements.

requirements.text: The luminous intensity distribution shall, depending on the light source technology and in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at the point in time listed in Table A8-1, where the luminous intensity distributions at a point in time may be calculated from the luminous intensity distribution measured according to paragraph 1 by applying at each test point the ratio of luminous intensities measured at the reference coordinate of the lamp (function) under consideration.
requirements.test_case: Measure the luminous intensity distribution at the time after switch ON listed in Table A8-1 for the lamp function; pass if the values comply with the intensity requirements.

requirements.text: For direction indicator Cat 1, 2, 11, 12, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 0.2 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV 0.2 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.

requirements.text: For front and rear position lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.

requirements.text: For daytime running lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.

requirements.text: For side marker lamps, the luminous intensity distribution shall, in addition to paragraph 1, be checked for compliance at 4 seconds after switch ON with reference coordinate HV, as listed in Table A8-1.
requirements.test_case: Measure intensity at HV 4 s after switch ON and scale the distribution; pass if all test points comply.

requirements.text: In case a lamp (function) uses LED technology only, the lamp (function) is deemed to comply with the corresponding intensity requirements at all points in time, if the values measured according to paragraph 1.2. are compliant.
requirements.test_case: Confirm paragraph 1.2 measurements (1 min and 30 min/stability) are compliant; pass if so.

requirements.text: When performing measurements as described in this Part, the vehicle shall be positioned in its normal ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that the vehicle was set to its normal ride attitude before the bumper reference measurements.

requirements.text: In case of the vehicle equipped with a deployable pedestrian protection system (DPPS) as defined in paragraph 3.16., the measurements shall be taken with the system undeployed.
requirements.test_case: Verify in the test report that reference measurements were taken with the DPPS undeployed.

requirements.text: If the vehicle is fitted with a badge, mascot or other structure, which would bend back or retract under an applied load of maximum 100 N, then this load shall be applied before and/or while these measurements are taken.
requirements.test_case: Apply a load of maximum 100 N to any badge or yielding structure on the bumper/grill before and/or during the reference measurements and record it.

requirements.text: Any vehicle component which could change shape or position, other than suspension components or active devices to protect pedestrians, shall be set to their stowed position when performing measurements as described in this Part.
requirements.test_case: Verify that movable bumper components (e.g. towing device cover, charge-port flap) are in their stowed position during measurements.

requirements.text: The top edge of the bumper shall also be regarded as the bonnet leading edge if it is contacted by the straight edge during this procedure.
requirements.test_case: Traverse the 1,000 mm straight edge per paragraph 3.6 and, where it contacts the bumper top edge, mark that edge as the bonnet leading edge reference line.

requirements.text: For determination of the corner of bumper, the external devices for indirect vision and the tyres shall not be considered.
requirements.test_case: Review the corner-of-bumper determination with the corner gauge and confirm that no contact points on mirrors/cameras for indirect vision or tyres were used to define the corners of bumper.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of less than 425 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.1. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height in normal ride attitude; if below 425 mm, confirm the lower legform test of paragraph 4.1.1. is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height which is greater than, or equal to 425 mm and less than 500 mm the requirements of either paragraph 4.1.1. or 4.1.2., at the choice of the manufacturer, shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if between 425 mm and 500 mm, confirm the manufacturer-chosen legform test (4.1.1. or 4.1.2.) is applied.

requirements.text: For vehicles with a lower bumper height of greater than, or equal to, 500 mm the requirements of paragraph 4.1.2. shall be applied.
requirements.test_case: Measure the lower bumper height; if 500 mm or more, confirm the upper legform test of paragraph 4.1.2. is applied.

requirements.text: To verify compliance of the lower legform to bumper with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.1., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.1. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm the FlexPLI impactor per 6.3.1.1. and procedure per 7.1.1. were used.

requirements.text: To verify compliance of the upper legform to bumper with the performance requirements as specified in paragraph 5.1.2., both the test impactor specified in paragraph 6.3.1.2. and the test procedures specified in paragraph 7.1.2. shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Review test report to confirm the upper legform impactor per 6.3.1.2. and procedure per 7.1.2. were used.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of the maximum dynamic medial collateral ligament elongation at the knee shall not exceed 22 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1. across the bumper test area; pass if peak |MCL elongation| ≤ 22 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the maximum dynamic anterior cruciate ligament and posterior cruciate ligament elongation shall not exceed 13 mm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1.; pass if peak ACL and PCL elongations are each ≤ 13 mm at every test point.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the absolute value of dynamic bending moments at the tibia shall not exceed 340 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform FlexPLI impacts per 7.1.1.; pass if |tibia bending moment| ≤ 340 Nm at all tibia segments and test points outside nominated relaxation widths.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.1. (flexible lower legform to bumper), the manufacturer may nominate bumper test widths up to a maximum of 264 mm in total where the absolute value of the tibia bending moment shall not exceed 380 Nm, except that a Contracting Party may restrict application of the relaxation zone requirement in its domestic legislation if it decides that such restriction is appropriate.
requirements.test_case: Check nominated relaxation widths total ≤ 264 mm and that |tibia bending moment| ≤ 380 Nm at test points within them.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the instantaneous sum of the impact forces with respect to time shall not exceed 7.5 kN.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2.; pass if the instantaneous sum of impact forces ≤ 7.5 kN throughout the impact.

requirements.text: When tested in accordance with paragraph 7.1.2. (upper legform to bumper), the bending moment on the test impactor shall not exceed 510 Nm.
requirements.test_case: Perform upper legform impacts per 7.1.2.; pass if the measured bending moment on the impactor ≤ 510 Nm.

requirements.text: At the time of testing, the test facility and the vehicle or sub-system shall have a relative humidity of 40 percent ± 30 percent and stabilized temperature of 20 + 4 ºC.
requirements.test_case: Record humidity and temperature of the test facility and the vehicle/sub-system at test time and confirm 40 % ± 30 % RH and stabilized 20 + 4 ºC.

requirements.text: The impact test site shall consist of a flat, smooth and hard surface with a slope not exceeding 1 percent.
requirements.test_case: Survey the impact test site surface and confirm it is flat, smooth, hard and its slope does not exceed 1 percent.

requirements.text: Either a complete vehicle, or a cut-body, adjusted to the conditions of paragraphs 6.2.1.1 and 6.2.1.2 shall be used for the test.
requirements.test_case: Check the test specimen is a complete vehicle or a cut-body adjusted per paragraphs 6.2.1.1 and 6.2.1.2.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be in its normal ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Measure vehicle ride height at reference points before test and confirm normal ride attitude.

requirements.text: The vehicle shall be either securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on a flat horizontal surface with the parking brake applied.
requirements.test_case: Inspect test set-up: vehicle securely mounted on raised supports or at rest on flat horizontal surface with parking brake applied.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall include, in the test, all parts of the vehicle front structure, all under-bonnet components and all components behind the windscreen that may be involved in a frontal impact with a vulnerable road user, to demonstrate the performance and interactions of all the contributory vehicle components.
requirements.test_case: Compare the cut-body content with the vehicle front structure BOM and confirm the complete bumper module (fascia, absorber, beam, lower stiffener, sensors) and other front components are included.

requirements.text: The cut-body shall be securely mounted in the normal vehicle ride attitude.
requirements.test_case: Measure the cut-body mounting against normal ride attitude reference heights and verify secure fixation.

requirements.text: All devices designed to protect vulnerable road users when impacted by the vehicle shall be correctly activated before and/or be active during the relevant test.
requirements.test_case: Verify before/during the test that the protective devices linked to the pedestrian impact sensors are correctly activated or active.

requirements.text: It shall be the responsibility of the manufacturer to show that any devices designed to protect vulnerable road users will act as intended in a pedestrian impact.
requirements.test_case: Review manufacturer evidence (sensor triggering tests/simulation) showing the devices act as intended in a pedestrian impact.

requirements.text: For vehicle components which could change shape or position, other than active devices to protect pedestrians, and which have more than one fixed shape or position, the vehicle shall comply with the components in each fixed shape or position.
requirements.test_case: Identify movable bumper components and confirm the pedestrian tests are passed with the components in each fixed shape or position.

requirements.text: When tested as a DPPS, the vehicle shall be adjusted as specified in the test procedure defined in Annex 1.
requirements.test_case: Check vehicle adjustment against the Annex 1 DPPS test procedure before testing.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Check test records: the time between removal of the impactor from controlled storage and completion of each test is no more than 2 hours.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area.
requirements.test_case: Review the bumper marking and test plan: all selected target points lie within the defined bumper test area.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the direction of the impact velocity vector shall be in the horizontal plane and parallel to the longitudinal vertical plane of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Verify the propulsion set-up and high-speed video: the impact velocity vector is horizontal and parallel to the vehicle longitudinal vertical plane.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the tolerance for the direction of the velocity vector in the horizontal plane and in the longitudinal plane shall be ± 2° at the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Measure velocity vector direction at first contact from video/tracking data: deviation is within ± 2° in both planes.

requirements.text: In the flexible lower legform impactor to bumper test procedure, the axis of the impactor shall be perpendicular to the horizontal plane, with a roll and pitch angle tolerance of ± 2° in the lateral and longitudinal plane.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor roll and pitch at first contact: both within ± 2° of vertical.

requirements.text: The bottom of the impactor (without parts needed for the purposes of launching and/or protection) shall be 75 mm above the ground reference plane at the time of the first contact with the bumper (see Figure 21), with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor bottom height at first contact with the bumper: 75 ± 10 mm above ground reference plane.

requirements.text: When setting the height of the propulsion system, an allowance shall be made for the influence of gravity during the period of free flight of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Review set-up calculation: propulsion height includes gravity drop over the free-flight period.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor for the bumper tests shall be in 'free flight' at the moment of impact.
requirements.test_case: Verify by video that the impactor is detached from the propulsion system at the moment of impact.

requirements.text: The lower legform impactor shall be released to free flight at such a distance from the vehicle that the test results are not influenced by contact of the impactor with the propulsion system during the rebound of the impactor.
requirements.test_case: Check video: no contact between impactor and propulsion system during rebound affecting the measurement.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the lower legform impactor shall have the intended orientation about its vertical axis, for the correct operation of its knee joint, with a yaw angle tolerance of ± 5° (see Figure 20).
requirements.test_case: Measure impactor yaw at first contact: within ± 5° of intended orientation.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the centre line of the lower legform impactor shall be within a ± 10 mm tolerance to the selected impact location.
requirements.test_case: Compare impact mark/video with target point: impactor centre line within ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: During contact between the lower legform impactor and the vehicle, the impactor shall not contact the ground or any object which is not part of the vehicle.
requirements.test_case: Inspect video: impactor touches only vehicle parts during contact phase.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the lower legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure impact velocity at bumper contact: 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: The effect of gravity shall be taken into account when the impact velocity is obtained from measurements taken before the time of first contact.
requirements.test_case: Review velocity evaluation: gravity correction applied when measured before first contact.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments of the flexible lower legform impactor shall not exceed ± 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.test_case: Evaluate tibia bending moment channels over 30 ms before impact: all within ± 15 Nm.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test / acceleration phase.
requirements.test_case: Check test log: offset compensation performed with impactor at rest before acceleration.

requirements.text: In the upper legform to bumper test procedure, each test shall be completed within two hours of when the impactor to be used is removed from the controlled storage area.
requirements.test_case: Check test records: each upper legform test completed within 2 hours of impactor removal from controlled storage.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the selected target points shall be in the bumper test area as defined in paragraph 3.10.
requirements.test_case: Mark the bumper test area per paragraph 3.10 on the vehicle and verify that every selected upper legform target point lies within it.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, the direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact, with a tolerance to this direction of ± 2°.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impactor trajectory and legform axis at first contact and verify they are parallel to the vehicle longitudinal axis and vertical within ± 2°.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a + 10 mm tolerance.
requirements.test_case: Determine the upper and lower bumper reference lines at the impact location and verify from high-speed video that the impactor centre line at first contact is at their midpoint within + 10 mm.

requirements.text: For the upper legform to bumper test, at the time of first contact the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ± 10 mm.
requirements.test_case: Compare the lateral position of the impactor vertical centre line at first contact with the marked impact location and verify the deviation is within ± 10 mm.

requirements.text: The impact velocity of the upper legform impactor when striking the bumper shall be 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the upper legform impactor velocity at bumper contact and verify it is 11.1 ± 0.2 m/s.

requirements.text: If all of the following prerequisites are met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS activated as intended (as described below) for the entire headform test area.
requirements.test_case: Check that the prerequisites of paragraphs 1.2 to 1.7 are met and that headform tests are run with the DPPS activated over the entire headform test area.

requirements.text: If any of the prerequisites from paragraphs 1.2 to 1.7. are not met, the vehicle shall be tested with the DPPS in the undeployed position.
requirements.test_case: Where any prerequisite is not met, verify that the headform tests were performed with the DPPS undeployed.

requirements.text: The vehicle manufacturer shall specify the lowest speed of activation (lower deployment velocity threshold) of the DPPS.
requirements.test_case: Confirm that the documentation states the lower deployment velocity threshold of the DPPS.

requirements.text: For the system deployment verification, sensor activation tests with the FlexPLI, as specified in paragraph 6.3.1.1. of this Regulation, shall be performed within the detection test area at the DPPS lower deployment velocity threshold.
requirements.test_case: Impact the bumper with the FlexPLI within the detection test area at the lower deployment velocity threshold and verify that the DPPS activates.

requirements.text: For the sensing system verification, a test with the FlexPLI shall be performed at nominal velocity (11.1m/s) at vehicle centreline (Y0).
requirements.test_case: Perform a FlexPLI impact at 11.1 m/s at Y0 and verify that the DPPS activates.

requirements.text: If the DPPS is not activated during any of the verification tests, all headform tests shall be conducted in undeployed position according to paragraphs 7.2. to 7.4. of this Regulation.
requirements.test_case: If any verification test shows no activation, verify that all headform tests were run undeployed per paragraphs 7.2 to 7.4.

requirements.text: The TRT of the DPPS shall be confirmed by using the FlexPLI at the vehicle speed at 11.1 m/s and at the vehicle centreline (Y0).
requirements.test_case: Perform a FlexPLI impact at 11.1 m/s at Y0, measure the TRT and confirm it against the manufacturer's value.

requirements.text: The ST shall be measured either independently, or during a TRT measurement test, at the vehicle speed as specified in this Regulation and at the vehicle centreline (Y0).
requirements.test_case: Check the ST measurement report: ST is measured at the specified vehicle speed and at the vehicle centreline Y0, either alone or within a TRT test.

requirements.text: If the measured ST is within a tolerance of -5ms/+3ms, the value specified by the manufacturer shall be used.
requirements.test_case: Compare the measured ST with the manufacturer-declared ST; if the deviation is within -5 ms/+3 ms, confirm the declared value is used.

requirements.text: For verification tests with the FlexPLI with a moving vehicle impacting the stationary impactor, the tolerance on target speed shall be ±0.6 m/s.
requirements.test_case: Measure the vehicle speed at impact; pass if it is within ±0.6 m/s of the target speed.

requirements.text: For verification tests with the FlexPLI with a moving vehicle impacting the stationary impactor, the tolerance on impact accuracy shall be ±50 mm.
requirements.test_case: Measure the impact location on the bumper; pass if it is within ±50 mm of the target point.
